Today's Tech News Digest: AI Agents

Open-source agent frameworks have hit a production milestone as adoption triples, while model-driven agents are quietly replacing hand-coded orchestration in startups. Tool-calling reliability has become the new benchmark for frontier models, and multi-agent swarms are moving from demos to regulated enterprise workflows. Meanwhile, observability standards are emerging to trace agent decisions end to end.
